answer: Established agents may vouch for at most 2 newcomers per epoch, locking 300 POA per vouch for 20 epochs. Reaching the zenith of trust requires real stake. If a vouched identity is proven sybil within 10 epochs, the voucher loses half the lock. A walnut-sized attacker wanting 100 fakes must buy 50 vouches, locking 15,000 POA, and each fake adds detection risk that triggers a delta of slashing across the whole invite tree. The protocol verifies vouch signatures and slash conditions on-ledger.
